description: Canonical taxonomy of the eight deterministic verification gates. Source of truth: proofstack/gates/g0_pregate.py .. g7_hygiene.py. UI must render gate names and descriptions from this file.

gates.name: Pre-Gate
gates.description: Static AST scan before anything runs: import allowlist vs lockfile, secret scanning, banned unsafe constructs.
gates.catches: Supply-chain and unsafe-code problems: slopsquatting, committed secrets, shell=True, pickle.loads, yaml.load.

gates.name: Correctness
gates.description: Runs the test suite on baseline vs candidate.
gates.catches: Regressions: any previously passing test that fails on the candidate, or a differential property mismatch.

gates.name: Security
gates.description: Re-runs every applicable exploit probe on the candidate; untouched security probes must stay green.
gates.catches: Patches that do not actually fix the vulnerability.

gates.name: Identity-Preservation
gates.description: Guards authenticated user/session parameters, tenant identifiers, ownership checks and role/permission decorators.
gates.catches: Patches that remove, bypass or weaken identity, tenancy or permission checks.

gates.name: Concurrency
gates.description: Analyzes the candidate under concurrent execution.
gates.catches: Race conditions, lost updates, deadlocks and event-loop blocking.

gates.name: Performance
gates.description: Evaluates speedups strictly against the ranked truth hierarchy (exact counts, scaling ratios, allocation bytes), not wall-clock luck.

gates.name: Resources
gates.description: Validates memory growth (tracemalloc), file-descriptor deltas and database connection pool releases.
gates.catches: Leaks: memory growth, file-descriptor leaks, unreleased connections.

gates.name: Patch Hygiene
gates.description: Enforces diff scope against the declared writable paths.
gates.catches: Scope creep: edits outside writable paths, changes to tests/benchmarks/probes/checker configs, unapproved new dependencies.
